notes: *for the fatherless* puts the recast construct relation on the rectum under rule 19, with the supplied *the* joining it under rule 46; the head stays on the lexeme-bearing word.
The lĕ before the infinitive takes the written *in* of the gerund recasting (rule 52's *by keeping* sentence), while the dative lĕ of *giving him* is unrepresented under rule 40.
